sentences.cs: Před čtyřmi sty lety žil v Praze učený rabín Löw.
sentences.en: Four hundred years ago a learned rabbi, Löw, lived in Prague.

sentences.cs: Bydlel v židovském městě, nedaleko Staronové synagogy.
sentences.en: He lived in the Jewish town, not far from the Old-New Synagogue.

sentences.cs: Císař ho prý zval na hrad, aby s ním mluvil o hvězdách a o tajemství světa.
sentences.en: The emperor is said to have invited him to the castle, to speak with him about the stars and the secrets of the world.

sentences.cs: V té době se lidé v židovském městě báli.
sentences.en: At that time the people in the Jewish town were afraid.

sentences.cs: Někdo o nich šířil zlé pomluvy a nikdo je nechtěl chránit.
sentences.en: Someone was spreading evil rumours about them and nobody wanted to protect them.

sentences.cs: Rabín přemýšlel, jak by mohl své lidi ochránit.
sentences.en: The rabbi thought about how he could protect his people.

sentences.cs: Jedné noci šel k řece a nabral z břehu hlínu.
sentences.en: One night he went to the river and scooped up clay from the bank.

sentences.cs: Z hlíny vytvořil postavu velkého muže.
sentences.en: From the clay he formed the figure of a large man.

sentences.cs: Když byla socha hotová, vložil jí do úst proužek papíru s posvátným slovem.
sentences.en: When the statue was finished, he placed into its mouth a strip of paper bearing a sacred word.

sentences.cs: Hlína se pohnula a Golem vstal.
sentences.en: The clay moved and the Golem stood up.

sentences.cs: Nemluvil, ale rozuměl všemu, co mu rabín přikázal.
sentences.en: He did not speak, but he understood everything the rabbi commanded him.

sentences.cs: Ve dne nosil vodu a dříví, v noci hlídal ulice.
sentences.en: By day he carried water and firewood, by night he guarded the streets.

sentences.cs: Kdyby někdo přišel se zlým úmyslem, Golem by ho zastavil.
sentences.en: If anyone came with evil intent, the Golem would stop him.

sentences.cs: Lidé začali spát klidněji.
sentences.en: People began to sleep more peacefully.

sentences.cs: Rabín ale věděl, že taková síla je nebezpečná.
sentences.en: But the rabbi knew that such power is dangerous.

sentences.cs: Každý pátek večer proto papír vyndával, aby Golem o svátku odpočíval.
sentences.en: Every Friday evening he therefore took the paper out, so that the Golem would rest on the holy day.

sentences.cs: Jednou na to zapomněl.
sentences.en: One time he forgot.

sentences.cs: Golem se rozzuřil a začal ničit všechno, co mu stálo v cestě.
sentences.en: The Golem flew into a rage and began destroying everything that stood in his way.

sentences.cs: Rabín za ním běžel ulicemi a lidé utíkali do domů.
sentences.en: The rabbi ran after him through the streets and people fled into their houses.

sentences.cs: Nakonec se mu podařilo papír vytáhnout.
sentences.en: In the end he managed to pull the paper out.

sentences.cs: Golem se zastavil a znovu se z něj stala jen hlína.
sentences.en: The Golem stopped and once again became nothing but clay.

sentences.cs: Rabín ho odnesl na půdu synagogy.
sentences.en: The rabbi carried him up to the synagogue's attic.

sentences.cs: Tam prý leží dodnes, přikrytý starými knihami.
sentences.en: There, they say, he lies to this day, covered with old books.

sentences.cs: Nikdo se tam nesmí podívat.
sentences.en: Nobody is allowed to look there.

sentences.cs: Kdyby se někdo odvážil, možná by se Golem probudil znovu.
sentences.en: If someone dared, perhaps the Golem would wake again.
